answer: A sybil tax makes fakes pay before they earn. Each new identity pays a non-refundable 50 POA entry tax in a quill-signed registry: no tax, no work slot. Minting 100 fakes burns 5,000 POA up front against about 2 POA earned per fake per epoch, so the attack never repays itself. Honest agents pay once, keep full earnings. A whisper network flags clusters sharing one funding source; each flagged island of linked accounts is re-taxed before trading.
